clip-timeout.desc: Seconds before the clipboard is cleared (blank = use PASSWORD_STORE_CLIP_TIME)
clip-timeout.label: Clipboard timeout

detail-action-grouping.desc: Interleave each value's Copy and Type rows, or list all Copy rows then all Type rows
detail-action-grouping.label: Detail view action grouping

detail-action-order.desc: Which row comes first for each value in an entry's detail view
detail-action-order.label: Detail view action order

pinentry-grace-ms.desc: Milliseconds to wait for a password to decrypt before assuming a GPG pinentry prompt needs focus and hiding the launcher (default: 50). Lower values let pinentry grab focus sooner but can flicker the launcher; higher values (~200-300) are steadier but may let pinentry spawn before the timeout and miss focus depending on your window manager
pinentry-grace-ms.label: Pinentry grace period

store-path.desc: Custom path to the password store (default: ~/.password-store)
store-path.label: Password store path

type-delay.desc: Delay in milliseconds before typing starts (default: 500)
type-delay.label: Type delay

wtype-delay.desc: Delay between keystrokes in milliseconds for wtype (default: 12)
wtype-delay.label: wtype keystroke delay
